none: PAS CAM-83A4B3: Roman Coin : Copper-alloy Contemporary copy of a Nummus of Constantius II
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy contemporary copy of a nummus of Constantius II. FEL TEMP REPARATIO. Mint uncertain, c.AD355-361, (Reece period 18). Reverse legend reads [FEL TEMP REPARATIO]. Reverse shows soldier advancing left, spearing fallen horseman. Obverse shows an unclear bust. Obverse legend reads [ ]. Condition is poor. Weight is 1.35g, diameter is 14.77mm
